sources.title: Liturgy Office — Background: Liturgical Calendars, Regional

notes: Calendar overlays describe nominal celebrations; they do not determine what is observed on a particular year/date.
Do not infer colour, readings, holy-day obligation, or precedence solely from the rank in these records.
Retain all candidates on a date; a separate precedence engine selects the applicable observance.
Five calendar dates cover six patron saints because Cyril and Methodius are celebrated together on 14 February.
